blocks.text: MANILA — The lawyer of veteran journalist Philip Lustre Jr. on Monday said he would ask the Department of Justice (DOJ) to investigate alleged irregularities in the journalist’s arrest over a cyberlibel case in Davao City, including claims that Lustre was deprived of due process.
